title: Spooky Slider
description: Slide the puzzle pieces to complete eerie Halloween images in *Spooky Slider*! Test your skills in this spooky-themed sliding jigsaw puzzle game with multiple levels and hauntingly fun challenges. Can you solve the puzzles before time runs out?
instructions: Use your mouse or touchpad to slide the puzzle pieces into the correct positions Rearrange the pieces until the spooky image is complete Finish the puzzle before time runs out to win
